capabilities: Create discourse nodes (Question, Claim, Evidence, Source) from text, menus, or commands
Define custom node types with templates, colors, and descriptions
Define relation types such as supports, opposes, informs, and derivedFrom
Create and view relations between nodes in a sidebar context widget
Draw discourse nodes and relations on tldraw-based canvases
extras: Full documentation lives on an external website; the README covers installation, setup, and commands but not deeper reference material.
problem: Obsidian notes lack semantic structure for modeling scientific discourse, making it hard to break research into atomic, reusable argument units.

relations.evidence: Discourse Graphs depends on the Datacore plugin, so install Datacore first.
The Discourse Graphs plugin uses tldraw to create canvases in Obsidian.

summary: Discourse graph plugin that adds typed nodes (questions, claims, evidence, sources) and typed relations to structure scientific argumentation.
